paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role on Global Prime Finance. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Owning a single core metric like PMGMS and explaining why it moves across countries and cohorts is the kind of problem I like.

At Lenovo I defined requirements and did the QA for AI-powered dashboards with predictive metrics, and built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, benchmarking past allocations and finding 30% efficiency gains to guide reinvestment.

Using AI for the repeatable reporting and keeping the judgment calls with finance is how I've worked so far. Monthly reporting, operating plans and digging into member spend all build on that. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
